title: centaurium africanum
intro: Centaurium africanum, commonly known as African centaury, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Gentianaceae family. It is traditionally used in medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Centaurium africanum include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and soothe respiratory problems, making it a popular natural remedy in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, iridoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
